claim: Independent opt-in GitHub branch reconciler with SHA compare-and-swap and readback
learning: Accepted update-branch responses do not prove integration; compare new PR head against current base before reporting verified.
root_cause: The old inline Janitor step could be skipped after a preceding failure and treated an accepted GitHub update-branch request as an update without independent post-update head verification.
prevention_rule: Run sync as an independent job; use expected_head_sha, require explicit enrollment, and verify open PR plus refreshed head with zero base-commit drift before reporting success.

outcome_evidence.local_tests: 4 regression tests were previously exercised; protected Required, CodeQL and production outcomes remain unproven
